definitions.exponent: contraction exponent per pass (n iterations) of a SQUARED error, in nats; negative: growth.
definitions.c, g: c = gamma n lambda and g = gamma lambda = c / n for a mode of eigenvalue lambda of the common Hessian.
definitions.fixed_g.<g>: iid_exact[n]: order_model.iid_exponent(n, n g), exact exponent of E e^2 for i.i.d. indices; iid_limit: 2 (1 - g)/(2 - g); rr_exact[n]: order_model.rr_ms_exponent(n, n g), exact exponent of E e^2 for the reshuffled order; rr_limit: min(2, log((2 - g)/g)); rr_mean[n]: exponent of the squared mean (first-moment pass matrix).
definitions.fixed_g.crossing: g at which g/(2 - g) = exp(-2), i.e. 2/(1 + e^2).
definitions.rr_best.<n>: c maximising order_model.rr_ms_exponent(n, c) over [1, n] (bounded scalar search) and the maximum.
definitions.typical.<n>.<c>: single runs of the scalar model with i.i.d. indices, 12 seeds, 260 passes, state rescaled at every pass; exponent of one run = minus the least-squares slope of the pass-end values of log max(e^2, max_j psi_j^2) over the passes 60..260; median, min, max over the seeds; pooled: slope of the seed average of that logarithm between the two ends of the window, with its standard error over the seeds; expectation: exact exponent of E e^2 (order_model.iid_exponent); rr: exact exponent of E e^2 under reshuffling (order_model.rr_ms_exponent); heuristic: order_model.iid_typical_heuristic(n, c).
definitions.typical.heuristic_error: max and median of |heuristic - median| over the cells with c >= 8 and c/n <= 0.05, and over the cells with c <= 4.
definitions.logistic.<problem>: L_eff: order_model.effective_curvature_glm(X, h, lambda) at the optimum, h_i the second derivative of the logistic loss; L_eff_over_R2, L_eff_over_mean_Li (mean_i of h_i ||x_i||^2 + lambda), L_eff_over_lmax (lambda_max(F''(eta_*))); by_step[gammaR2]: g = gamma L_eff, cap = log((2 - g)/g) (null for g >= 2), law = r_rr(c_min) of experiment B4, two_term = min(law, cap), measured = median reshuffled exponent of B4 (null unless every run converged), rel_err_law and rel_err_two_term = measured / prediction - 1; iid_measured = median i.i.d. exponent of B4 and iid_expectation_heuristic = 1 - g/(2 - g).
definitions.logistic.summary: over the (problem, step) pairs with a measured reshuffled exponent, by group of steps and of kappa: number of pairs, max and median of |rel_err| for the law (R3) alone and for the two-term law, and the number of pairs within 10%.
definitions.logistic.best_step: gammaR2 at which the two terms are equal (brentq on the step), the value of the two-term law there, and the best step and exponent of the grid of experiment B4.
definitions.orthogonal.<c>: components on orthogonal directions, c = gamma n lambda = gamma R^2, n = 1000: cyclic = exact exponent (2x2 pass map), cyclic_limit = the same for n -> infinity, rr and iid = Lyapunov exponents of single runs (40000 passes, seeds [0, 1, 2]: median, min, max).
definitions.note: numbers printed in theory/B4_sampling_order.tex outside its Outcome paragraph; each key names the function of vrlab.order_model or vrlab.bounds that produces it (see the comments of the note).
